verdicts.explanation: Table 2 lists σbulk 1.43 x 10-7 S/cm and Ea 1.11 eV as the first row (x=0), with the 250C header read as 25 °C (Section 3.4.2 also says 25 °C). Table 1 has no x=0 row, so null relative density is correct.
The second Table 2 row (x=0.05) gives σbulk 4.85 x 10-6 S/cm and Ea 0.58 eV, and Table 1 gives relative density 83.10% for x=0.05. Sintering at 1050 °C for 7.30 h applies to all samples.

The text states 7.23 x 10-6 S/cm at room temperature for 0.10 Ge with Ea 0.56 eV, matching Table 2 (σbulk at 250C, read as 25 °C). Table 1 gives relative density 86.44% for x=0.10. The unit_evidence_quote is null, but the S/cm unit appears in the record's own evidence quote, so this is minor.
The fourth Table 2 row (x=0.15) gives σbulk 2.86 x 10-6 S/cm and Ea 0.61 eV, and Table 1 gives relative density 80.74% for x=0.15.
The fifth Table 2 row (x=0.20) gives σbulk 1.36 x 10-6 S/cm and Ea 0.98 eV, and Table 1 gives relative density 80.35% for x=0.20. All values are experimental and not cited from elsewhere.
